groups.title: Unit Testing with Vitest
groups.question: You are writing unit tests for a Vue component that calls an API and emits events. Explain how you would test it in isolation.

followUps.Mocking in Vitest: vi.mock and Spies: How do vi.mock and spies isolate the component?

evidence.text: mount renders a component in a test environment.
Tests trigger events like clicks and inputs.
Tests check rendered output and emitted events.
vi.mock replaces imported modules with test doubles.
Spies record calls so tests can check them.
The component is tested without real API calls.

groups.title: Testing Nuxt-specific Code
groups.question: You need to test a Nuxt server route and middleware with real requests, and composables that use Pinia keep sharing state between tests. Explain Nuxt-specific testing.

followUps.Testing Composables with Pinia: How do you give each test a fresh Pinia store?

evidence.text: It starts a real Nuxt app in tests.
Tests can send real HTTP requests to server routes.
It covers middleware and SSR behaviour that unit tests miss.
Each test creates a new Pinia instance.
createTestingPinia creates fresh stores with stubbed actions.
Tests no longer share state.

notEnough: Only saying you set up Pinia.

groups.title: End-to-End Testing with Playwright
groups.question: You want end-to-end tests for login and checkout that do not break whenever a button label changes. Explain how you would use Playwright.

followUps.Playwright Test Architecture: What does Playwright run, and what can tests check?
followUps.Page Object Model Pattern: How does the page object model keep tests maintainable?

evidence.text: Playwright drives real browsers like Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
Tests automate clicks, typing and navigation.
They can assert on the page, network requests and storage.

notEnough: Only saying Playwright tests the UI.

evidence.text: Page objects hold each page's selectors and actions.
Tests read like user steps.
A UI change only requires updating the page object.

groups.title: Deployment and CI/CD
groups.question: You are deploying your Nuxt app to Vercel and want every pull request checked before merging. Explain deployment presets and the CI pipeline.

followUps.Nuxt Deployment Targets and Presets: What does a Nitro deployment preset do?
followUps.CI/CD Pipeline for Nuxt Apps: What should a CI pipeline for a Nuxt app run?

evidence.text: Presets build the output for a target platform.
Targets include Node servers, static hosting, Vercel and Cloudflare.
The preset must match the platform or the app fails at runtime.

notEnough: Only saying Nuxt can deploy anywhere.

evidence.text: It runs type checking and linting.
It runs unit and end-to-end tests.
It verifies the production build on every pull request before merging.
